<module id="traffic_light">
    <description>Traffic light controller with red, yellow, and green indicators and a pedestrian button.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset.</input>
        <input id="clk">Clock.</input>
        <input id="pass_request">Request signal for allowing vehicles to pass.</input>
        <output id="clock" width_description="[7:0]">An 8-bit output representing the count value of the internal counter.</output>
        <output id="red">Red light output.</output>
        <output id="yellow">Yellow light output.</output>
        <output id="green">Green light output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter>idle = 2'b00</parameter>
        <parameter>s1_red = 2'b01</parameter>
        <parameter>s2_yellow = 2'b10</parameter>
        <parameter>s3_green = 2'b11</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="cnt" width="8">Internal counter for timing purposes.</register>
        <register id="state" width="2">Current state of the traffic light controller.</register>
        <register id="p_red" width="1">Previous value of the red signal.</register>
        <register id="p_yellow" width="1">Previous value of the yellow signal.</register>
        <register id="p_green" width="1">Previous value of the green signal.</register>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // State transition logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                state <= idle;
                p_red <= 0;
                p_yellow <= 0;
                p_green <= 0;
                cnt <= 10;
            end else begin
                case (state)
                    idle: begin
                        state <= s1_red;
                        p_red <= 1;
                        p_yellow <= 0;
                        p_green <= 0;
                        cnt <= 10;
                    end
                    s1_red: begin
                        if (cnt == 0) begin
                            state <= s3_green;
                            p_red <= 0;
                            p_yellow <= 0;
                            p_green <= 1;
                            cnt <= 60;
                        end
                    end
                    s2_yellow: begin
                        if (cnt == 0) begin
                            state <= s1_red;
                            p_red <= 1;
                            p_yellow <= 0;
                            p_green <= 0;
                            cnt <= 10;
                        end
                    end
                    s3_green: begin
                        if (cnt == 0) begin
                            state <= s2_yellow;
                            p_red <= 0;
                            p_yellow <= 1;
                            p_green <= 0;
                            cnt <= 5;
                        end
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end

        // Counting logic
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n || pass_request && p_green) begin
                cnt <= 10;
            end else if (p_green && !green) begin
                cnt <= 60;
            end else if (p_yellow && !yellow) begin
                cnt <= 5;
            end else if (p_red && !red) begin
                cnt <= 10;
            end else begin
                cnt <= cnt - 1;
            end
        end

        // Output assignment
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                red <= 0;
                yellow <= 0;
                green <= 0;
            end else begin
                red <= p_red;
                yellow <= p_yellow;
                green <= p_green;
            end
        end

        // Assign output clock
        assign clock = cnt;
    </implementation>
</module>
